Bartenders Glossary

Bartender's Glossary

Bartender’s Glossary is a website that delivers a quick guide to creating the bar’s most popular drinks and using its tools. As a bartender, I used my years of knowledge to write and design the content for the page. The goal of the project was to create a space for bartenders to educate themselves on how to use their bar to its fullest potential, make drinks that shape the customer experience, and quickly display recipes for those forgetful moments during a shift.

The website features organized sections displaying cocktail recipes, shot recipes, and explaining bar tools. I prioritized the website to have a quick interaction time with navigation tools and a single page to decrease clicks and improve content delivery time. The website utilizes a simple color palette and typography to emphasize the content and improve user experience.
